note.fr: La candidature est examinée par une commission : résultats scolaires (60 %), savoir-être (20 %), méthodes de travail (10 %), motivation (5 %), engagement (5 %). Spécialités recommandées : Mathématiques et NSI, Mathématiques et Physique-Chimie, ou Mathématiques et Sciences de l'Ingénieur.
note.en: Application is reviewed by a commission: academic results (60%), soft skills (20%), working methods (10%), motivation (5%), engagement (5%). Recommended specialisations: Mathematics and Computer Science, Mathematics and Physics-Chemistry, or Mathematics and Engineering Sciences.

evidence.quote: • Spécialités Mathématiques et Numérique et Sciences Informatiques

notes: The programme's own page is the Parcoursup fiche; it states "178 euros" tuition per year, which applies to non-differentiated-fee students only (French/EU/EEA etc.). For a Moroccan (non-EU) applicant with a foreign diploma, the applicable fee is the differentiated fee of 650 EUR per year according to the Université de Rennes international students page, which also states that from 2027-2028 it will rise to 2,902 EUR. Application channel is not extracted per task instructions: a foreign-diploma applicant applies via Etudes en France / DAP. The Parcoursup fiche's C1 French level is listed on the fiche itself (general for the formation); dossiers are screened on Parcoursup criteria but the international route is separate.
